name: io.github.d-khomenko/clipboard-history-mcp
description: Type-aware, secret-safe clipboard history exposed to Claude via MCP. macOS + Linux. One Rust binary.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_VAULT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Optional Obsidian vault directory. When set, the daemon mirrors every non-secret clip to <vault>/clipboard/YYYY-MM/<id>-<kind>-<slug>.md plus a daily-note bullet. Secrets are never mirrored.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_HISTORY_MAX
environmentVariables.description: Ring-buffer size for unpinned clips (default 1000). Pinned clips sit outside the limit.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_NEVER_STORE_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Paranoid mode — set to '1' to drop all secret/image/file clips at capture time. Metadata-only logging.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_MAX_BLOB_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Max byte size for image / file payloads (default 26214400 = 25 MB). Larger blobs are skipped with a WARN log.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_IGNORE_APPS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated app names to skip (e.g. '1Password,Bitwarden'). Secondary defence after the NSPasteboard concealed-type check.

environmentVariables.name: CLIPBOARD_CAPTURE_WINDOW_TITLE
environmentVariables.description: Set to '1' to record the front window title for each capture. Requires Accessibility permission on macOS.
